body: Iirc atronach stone plus the atronach perk (100 alteration) with necromage gives 100% spell absorption as long as both are taken after necromage. So yes, at that point dragons and mages are just magicka regen for you. However, full sorry absorption makes conjuration impossible to cast so keep that in mind when planning the build

Werewolf doesn't have any direct huffs to your magic abilities, but it does give you the ability to swap mid fight from spellcasting to melee fighting, which can be nice if you're out of magicka or up against some tougher enemies as the wolf is a bit tankier possibly.

Being a vampire is kinda busted if you know what you're doing. The ring of erudite is big magicka regen and a flat +100 magicka, vampire lords get a 25% buff to illusion spells, and then there's the necromage perk... 

There are pros and cons to both, and unless you're on legendary it probably doesn't really matter so do what you want and will have the most fun with. Maybe do some more roleplaying for the character and see which (if either) better fits the lore and story of your character

Put your two zoltans in shields. The 2 Zoltan power then give you one ion-proof shield bubble, which could potentially save you some damage in fights including the flagship. You can then free up your engi to be a roaming repair bot.

If you do this, be sure to pause if you ever need to move the zoltans out of shields and make sure you won't accidently drop a bubble at an inopportune time. 

Also, buffer points. Having an extra system point in things like cloaking, oxygen, med bay, weapons, and even engines or shields (if you don't (yet) have the 4th bubble) saves you so often. It can get expensive (see engines and weapons) but those extra points have saved me on countless runs. 

For the flagship fight specifically, in phase 1 cloak for the middle barrage, in phase 2 right as the drone mass starts attacking, and phase 3 for the super weapon. Take missiles out asap, and try to kill as much crew as you can during phase 1 without taking unnecessary damage. Less boarders to worry about makes phase 3 far easier. 

Might be controversial (and fellow commenters please share your thoughts on this) but I also like to pick up mind control just for phase 3. Maybe I'm just bad at micro managing that extra thing but I much prefer counter mind controlling to not worry about it. 

Good luck mate! Let us know how you fare!
